implementation.report: Phase 01 implementation evidence (deepseek-v4-pro:high). Root POM converted to pom-packaging aggregator; modules mindspice-core (Enforcer bannedDependencies + Automatic-Module-Name io.mindspice.core), mindspice-core-autoconfigure, magenta-app (all Magenta sources moved 1:1 from root src/, 387 main + 119 test Java files preserved). Deviation: magenta-app submodule required because Maven rejects jar packaging with <modules>. Build: mvn clean verify passes (1271/1272; 1 pre-existing flaky ChatControllerTest passes in isolation). Context startup verified. Validator subsequently fixed start.sh for -pl magenta-app.

validations.report: Phase 01 validation VERDICT: PASS (deepseek-v4-pro:max). Validator independently verified: Enforcer bannedDependencies (5 coordinates) and Automatic-Module-Name io.mindspice.core present; magenta-app preserved all 19 original dependencies + spring-boot-maven-plugin; mvn clean verify passes (1271/1272; 1 pre-existing flaky ChatControllerTest verified passing in isolation); context startup verified (Magenta2Application started ~3.4s, Tomcat on ephemeral port); source preservation exact (387 main + 119 test Java files); no root src leftovers. Deviation ruling: magenta-app submodule ACCEPTED (Maven rejects jar packaging with <modules>; standard aggregator layout; later phases must use magenta-app/ path prefix and -pl magenta-app for spring-boot:run). Validator edit: start.sh now runs mvn -pl magenta-app spring-boot:run with -Dspring-boot.run.workingDirectory to keep config resolution. Remaining risk: pre-existing flaky ChatControllerTest (race in async streaming + await(5s)), unrelated to this phase.
